notes.title: Demo Update for German Users
notes.notes:
I recently discovered that my demo was not displaying the download button for users in Germany. Although I had completed the required ratings form, it turns out that additional demo-specific fields were needed. I apologize for the delay in fixing this issue.

The problem has now been resolved, and the download button is visible for all German users. Thank you for your patience and understanding. I hope you enjoy playing the demo and I look forward to hearing your feedback!
